verdict.rationale: Every endpoint page on Mercury's ReadMe-hosted API Reference embeds a live 'Try It!' request runner. It comes with generated code samples in Shell, Node, Ruby, PHP and Python, a Bearer credentials field, per-endpoint parameters and response schemas. A probe independently confirmed the interactive runner is served (HTTP 200). Missing for 10: hands-on or community corroboration of running requests through the runner, and documentation that the runner can be pointed at the sandbox base URL for safe execution.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
